notes: Exploratory probe for the file-command slice (lexer.w:558-560, parser.y:180-181, main.w:504-511): '> "f" expr' evaluates expr and writes only the 'Value: ...' line to f (truncating), '>> "f" expr' appends; report lines such as 'Variable qfc: int' still go to stdout and a void-valued command writes nothing to the file; failing to open the target prints 'Failed to open <name>' on stderr, skips the line, and batch evaluation continues. Also probes whether a bare '<' quoted name is required for fromfile. Lines will be split into accepted and rejected fixtures from the oracle behavior; this probe file is not a differential fixture.
